content: {DRAFT} If CanNmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled is TRUE , the PNI bit in the received NM - PDU is set to 1 and the PNSR bit is set to 1 , CanNm module shall extract the PNC bit v ector from the received NM - PDU according to the partial network configuration ( NmPncBitVectorOffset and NmPncBitVectorLength of the corresponding NM - channel) and forward the PNC bit vector by calling Nm_ForwardSynchronizedPncShutdown .

If CanNmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled is TRUE , the PNI bit in the received NM - P DU is set to 1 and the PNSR bit is set to 1 , CanNm module shall extract the PNC bit v ector from the received NM - PDU according to the partial network configuration ( NmPncBitVectorOffset and NmPncBitVectorLength of the corresponding NM - channel) and forward t he PNC bit vector by calling Nm_ForwardSynchronizedPncShutdown .
